name: io.github.MemaxLabs/memax
title: Memax
description: Universal memory hub for AI agents. Push knowledge from any agent, recall it from any other. 10 tools: recall, push, get, list, hubs, hub_members, forget, capture, request_decision, topics. Cloud-hosted with cross-agent memory sharing.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token with your Memax API key (create one at memax.app or via `memax setup`)
